[[Blessed Griffon]]s wander in small herds, and are extremely territorial, aggressively attacking anything that isn't part of the herd, including other Blessed Griffons. [[Spellcaster]]s are at a particular disadvantage, as the Blessed Griffons possess [[Spell Breaker]].
